provenance: External calibrated Logitech, marker8 PnP and known-radius orange sphere tangent-cone fits; median of 40 actual camera frames
definition: Operational TCP origin = center of held 40 mm ping-pong ball at recorded gripper opening
axes_convention: TCP axes aligned with marker by convention; only origin calibrated
mount_assumption: Marker mounted on camera support upstream of wrist roll; fixed roll and gripper opening required; downstream roll errors not independently observed
sphere_diameter_source: Nominal 40 mm ping-pong ball; not independently measured with calipers

temporal_quality.note: Provisional single-frame 3 mm std gate failed; median aggregate checked instead. Multi-pose validation still required.

limitations: Origin estimate, not full 6D TCP calibration
Requires fixed wrist roll and constant grip/payload
